description: Run JavaScript in an isolated Pi QuickJS sandbox. Discover native provider functions with search, then call await tools.<name>(args). Use return, text() or console.log() for output. Promise.all supports parallel requests. Only final output reaches the client. No filesystem, network, Node APIs, modules or timers. Credentials stay on the host. At most 20 provider calls; 64 MiB heap; default deadline 60 seconds. Results are raw provider JSON. Async jobs return IDs: retrieve their status in a later call. No automatic retries. Calls already made are not undone on failure. State is not persisted between executions.

large_result_mode.description: How to handle oversized responses for this request. Use inline for remote/container transports; file is local shared-filesystem behavior. Defaults to OMNISEARCH_LARGE_RESULT_MODE or file.
